newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Lonrho Sugar says in talks, buy-out seen.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho Sugar says in talks, buy-out seen.

text.p: Lonrho Sugar Corp Ltd, listed in Swaziland and South Africa, said on Thursday that it is involved in talks which, if successful, could affect its share price.
The firm warned its shareholders to exercise caution when dealing in its shares.
The firm gave no further details in a brief announcement.
However, South Africa's Business Day newspaper reported that a list of contendors both locally and in Britain were looking to buy the firm, controlled by Britain's Lonrho Plc.
The firm said analysts had named South Africa's Tongaat Hulett and Illovo Sugar as possible buyers and added that Britain's Tate & Lyle and Associated British Foods could also be interested.
Lonrho Sugar has a market capitalisation of about 1.5 billion rand and plantation investments in Mauritius, Swaziland, Malawi and South Africa.
